correctness.rationale: Ou Theorem 6.6/Corollary 6.7 furnish for all large m a common interval of analytic creation thresholds l_(m,2) and l_(m,3), strict derivative ordering and C1 convergence. At b=0 the rotated itinerary ++(-)^(m-2)++(-)^(n-2), n=2,3, composed under S_a(x)=a-1-a|x| from x=0 yields exact border equation a^(m+n-1)(2-a)=2a^(n-1)(a-1)+1. For the roots approaching 2, exact asymptotic gives 2^m(2-a_(m,2))->5/2 and 2^m(2-a_(m,3))->9/4, hence d_m(0)=l_(m,2)(0)-l_(m,3)(0)~-2^-m/4. Ou Lemma 6.4 and stable-lamination endpoint formula yield limiting derivative difference d_inf_prime(0)=1. By crossing, strict derivative bounds and mean-value theorem b_m*=2^-m/4(1+o(1)), with a_m*->2. Independent symbolic polynomial composition checked for m=5..8,n=2,3 and numerical root separation for m=8,12,16,20 approaching 1/4. Correctness conditional on the cited source regularity/admissibility theorems, materially inspected in its full arxiv PDF.
